summary.en: The one pairing mark on the input side slides to the next item or token while the result beside the seam cuts on the same beat.
summary.zh: 输入侧唯一的配对标记滑到下一项或下一个词，同一拍上接缝另一侧的结果切换。

fits: Pairing items of a list or tokens of code with the results they make, one a beat.
notFor: Several marks at once; a mark that fades between places.

intent.en: Pair one input with one result at a time, on the beat the result changes.
intent.zh: 每次把一个输入和一个结果配对，就在结果切换的那一拍。

content.en: A list and the item to move to, or quoted lines and the next token.
content.zh: 一个列表和要移到的项，或引用的代码行和下一个词。

fits.zh: 把列表项或代码里的词与它们做出的结果一拍一个地配对。

notFor.zh: 同时多个标记；在两处之间淡入淡出的标记。

fits: any film whose input maps line by line to an output

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
